item.title: xLightGCN: Explainable Graph Neural Network Based Recommendation Systems with Most Influential Peers
item.description:
Calder Johnson, Robin A Cohen
Recommendation systems, systems that predict a user's preference for items in order to curate that user's feed, are a ubiquitous and central feature in online social networks. While they are a central piece of our modern digital infrastructure, many modern approaches are opaque black boxes, making them difficult to audit, understand, and assess the trustworthiness of. In this paper we present an exact, graph-based approach for generating explanations for decisions made by recommendation systems.
